title: neottia bigelowii
intro: Neottia bigelowii, commonly known as Bigelow's ladies' tresses, is a species of orchid native to North America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Neottia bigelowii include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it a potential treatment for wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
